name: Profile wall (your reels behind you, a counter in front)
what: A dark profile panel of your reels fills the wall behind you, above your shoulders and round your head: the tab mark slides to the reels and the grid fills tile by tile, while a smoke-glass counter rises in front of you under your chin and its number counts up (312 reels made, 1,248 posts, 2.4M views...) and pops as it lands. A light crosses the grid and the counter in the hold; the counter sinks away at the end. The Editor puts the panel behind you and the counter in front.
origin: MotionLab's own build after a design in Vibha Ramprakash's claude-video-effects (MIT), 2026-10-28
motion: f0-f10 the panel settles in (from 94 % and 22 px lower, decelerating), seen from f0; f4-f16 the tab mark slides to the reels tab (S-curve); from f5 a tile pops in every 2 f in reading order (from 85 % with a small overshoot, 7 f; 15 tiles upright, by f33); f3-f15 the counter rises in front under the chin (decelerating) and its number counts up f8-f42 (decelerating), then pops 8 % (8 f); a light crosses the counter f44-f68 and the grid f50-f80 (S-curve); the avatar ring turns and the panel floats 3 px in the hold; the last 9 f the counter sinks 30 px and the panel fades (accelerating)
